description: An advanced reinforced starship hull traversing relativistic space at near-light velocity, engineered with vivid multi-colored contrast for deep space black background visibility. Gleaming polished golden armor plating, vibrant neon cyan relativistic sub-light ion thruster engines, luminous electric cyan energy conduits running along the fuselage, rich cobalt blue deflection trim, and emerald sensor telemetry nodes. High-contrast vibrant color scheme that stands out brilliantly against pure black cosmic void. Hard surface sci-fi 3D game asset, optimized low-to-mid poly triangle topology suitable for WebXR on mobile, desktop, VR, and ARCore.
texture_prompt: Vivid multi-colored starship hull, polished reflective gold armor plating, bright glowing cyan relativistic ion engines and conduits, cobalt blue accents, emerald telemetry lights, extreme contrast on black space background, clean PBR textures, metallic gold, emissive cyan glow.
color_scheme: multi-colored high-contrast against black cosmic background (gold armor, cyan ion engines, emerald telemetry, violet phase)
